correctness.rationale: A peripheral white vertex has epsilon+w_i-1 white neighbors, a blue peripheral vertex epsilon+w_i, and the central vertex sum_i w_i. If any blade has at least three whites, no permissible skew force can reduce that blade below three even after all other blades clear. With blue center and w_i<=2, pairs of whites force each other then a blue blade vertex forces the remaining single white (m>=3). With white center, the profile w_i=2 for all blades is stalled, whereas any w_j=0 or 1 permits forcing the center first and then clearing. Counting admissible blue sets gives (1+x)F_m(x)^k-C(m,2)^k x^{k(m-2)} with F_m=x^m+mx^{m-1}+C(m,2)x^{m-2}. Exact coefficient analysis gives Z_-=k(m-2)+1, minimum-set count C(m,2)^(k-1)[C(m,2)+km] and failed forcing number km-2. Independently exhaustively enumerated all 2^N sets of W_(2,3), W_(2,4), W_(3,3), matching criterion, polynomial and extrema; infinite quantifiers rely on occupancy proof.
residual_risks: Finite exact checks are bounded and are not substituted for the explicitly reconstructed infinite proof or analytic distribution.
